CustomField.description: Lookup to the Contact who referred this investor Lead. Changed from Text(255) to Lookup(Contact) on 2026-08-15 by explicit user decision, superseding this field's previous description, which argued the opposite ("Deliberately Text, not a Lookup... Do not 'correct' this into a lookup"). The field held zero rows at the time of the change, so nothing was lost. ACCEPTED CONSEQUENCE: a referrer who is not a Salesforce Contact can no longer be recorded here — such a referral must either be created as a Contact first or captured in Description. This field now conforms to ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 3 (a role-named _By__c field is a lookup). It is carried to Contact.Referred_By__c on conversion by InvestorLeadConvertService.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the Contact who referred this investor, if they are already a Salesforce Contact.
CustomField.label: Referred By
